extension.name: sevenx_payment_stripe
extension.description: Stripe Payment Element gateway for eZ Publish 4 / Exponential CMS. Integrates the Stripe PaymentIntents API and Stripe.js Payment Element into the eZ Publish shop workflow. Supports cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Link, Stripe Tax, and all Stripe-enabled payment methods.
